projects.title: Ethiopian Marketplace
projects.summary: FastAPI classifieds marketplace backend for the Ethiopian market: multi-channel authentication, hierarchical categories and locations, filtered listings and an asynchronous media pipeline.
projects.overview:
A classifieds marketplace backend designed for the Ethiopian market. Users sign up with email/password, phone OTP, Google or Telegram, link several identities to one account and manage their device sessions.

Buyers browse listings with filters for hierarchical categories and locations, price and condition, using signed cursor-based pagination. Sellers upload photos that are validated, resized and moved through media lifecycle states by asynchronous workers.

features.title: Multi-channel authentication
features.description: Email/password with email verification, phone OTP, Google OAuth/OIDC and Telegram authentication.

features.title: Identity linking & sessions
features.description: Link several identities to one account; device sessions, token revocation, logout-all and refresh/access-token workflows.

features.title: Listing browsing
features.description: Filtering by hierarchical categories and locations, price and condition, with signed cursor-based pagination.

features.title: Media processing
features.description: Object storage, asynchronous workers, image validation and resizing, ownership checks and media lifecycle states.

features.title: Async data access
features.description: PostgreSQL data models with SQLAlchemy asynchronous sessions, optimized for the API's access patterns.

features.title: Caching & background work
features.description: Redis and Celery for caching, background processing and asynchronous workloads.

architecture.description: FastAPI modular backend on PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy async sessions. Redis and Celery handle caching and background jobs; media lives in object storage and is processed by workers. Containerized with Docker, with a production stack of Nginx, PostgreSQL, Redis, workers and object storage.

challenges.problem: One account, many ways to sign in
challenges.solution: Designed identity linking so email, phone, Google and Telegram identities attach to a single user, with per-device sessions, token revocation and logout-all.

challenges.problem: Stable pagination over changing, filtered listings
challenges.solution: Used signed cursor-based pagination instead of page offsets, so results stay consistent and cursors can't be tampered with.
Validated, resized and ownership-checked images in asynchronous workers, tracking each file through explicit media lifecycle states.

projects.title: Universal Booking Platform
projects.summary: Reusable multi-tenant booking SaaS for appointment-based businesses, with schema-based tenant isolation, configurable booking rules and role-based access.
projects.overview:
A reusable booking platform for appointment-based businesses, built at Adulis Media. Each business is a tenant with its own PostgreSQL schema.

Businesses configure their services, employees and schedules; customers book available slots. Booking rules are configurable per business — service durations, slot intervals and how an employee is chosen — so the same platform serves very different businesses.

features.title: Schema-based tenant isolation
features.description: PostgreSQL schemas per business with django-tenants.

features.title: Booking REST APIs
features.description: Authentication, services, employees, schedules, availability, bookings and customers.

features.title: Configurable booking rules
features.description: Different service durations, slot intervals and employee-selection strategies per business.

features.title: Role-based access
features.description: RBAC with strict tenant isolation across every workflow.

features.title: Reusable business services
features.description: Scheduling, customer management and service management built as shared services.

architecture.description: Django + Django REST Framework on PostgreSQL with django-tenants: a public schema for platform data and one schema per business. Business logic lives in reusable services; access is enforced with RBAC inside each tenant.

challenges.problem: One platform for businesses with different booking rules
challenges.solution: Made durations, slot intervals and employee-selection strategies configuration rather than code, so each tenant behaves differently on the same codebase.
Isolated each business in its own PostgreSQL schema and applied role-based access within it.

projects.title: Multi-Brand Multi-Domain Platform
projects.summary: One Laravel application serving several independent brands and top-level domains — replacing separate WordPress sites with shared administration and strict cross-site isolation.
projects.overview:
A centralized Laravel platform built at Adulis Media that replaced several independent WordPress websites with one maintainable application.

Each brand keeps its own domain, content, theme, blog and commerce features, while the business manages everything from shared administration. The site is resolved from the request host and every query, cache entry and background job runs in that site's context.

features.title: Host-based site resolution
features.description: The brand is resolved from the request's domain, with domain alias management.

features.title: Site-scoped data & themes
features.description: Site-scoped data access and dynamic themes per brand, with strict cross-site isolation.

features.title: Reusable modules
features.description: Business websites, blogs, e-commerce, booking, memberships and content management shared across brands.

features.title: Tenant-aware background work
features.description: Site context propagates into queued jobs; cache invalidation is scoped per site.

features.title: Shared administration
features.description: One admin for every brand instead of separate WordPress dashboards.

architecture.description: Laravel + Livewire on MySQL. Requests resolve a site from the host; site context is carried into queries, caches and queued jobs. Deployed on a Linux VPS behind Nginx with SSL, CI/CD, queues and database services.

challenges.problem: Replacing several WordPress sites with one application
challenges.solution: Modelled sites and domains explicitly so each brand keeps its own domain, content, theme and commerce while sharing one codebase and admin.
Propagated site context into background jobs and scoped cache invalidation per site, so queued work and caches never cross brands.

projects.title: EduCore ERP
projects.summary: Modular multi-tenant ERP for private schools, training centers and service organizations: SaaS subscriptions, CRM, academic programs and a full billing domain.
projects.overview:
An enterprise SaaS ERP for private schools, training centers, educational institutions and service-based organizations, designed with Domain-Driven Design and Clean Architecture.

The platform is split into modular domains — SaaS administration, CRM, academic/program management and billing — each with clear boundaries, multi-tenancy and role-based access.

features.title: SaaS domain
features.description: Organizations, plans, subscriptions, modules, permissions, branches and platform administration.

features.title: CRM
features.description: Customers, contacts, tags, notes, documents and custom fields.

features.title: Academic & program management
features.description: Periods, programs, levels, groups, enrollment and branch-specific programs.

features.title: Billing
features.description: Plans, subscriptions, invoices and items, payments, allocations, receipts, refunds, credit notes and discounts.

features.title: Payment allocation
features.description: Partial and selective payment of individual invoice items.

architecture.description: Laravel backend with a React frontend on PostgreSQL. Domain-Driven Design and Clean Architecture with modular domain boundaries (SaaS, CRM, academics, billing), multi-tenancy and RBAC.

challenges.problem: Customers paying part of an invoice
challenges.solution: Designed a payment-allocation model so a payment can cover some invoice items fully, others partially, and leave the rest open.

projects.title: EthioNotify
projects.summary: Multi-tenant notification infrastructure for developers: send transactional notifications and alerts through messaging channels with API keys, templates, scheduling and delivery logs.
projects.overview:
A notification SaaS for developers. Teams create projects, authenticate with API keys and send transactional notifications and alerts through messaging channels using templates — immediately or on a schedule.

Delivery is asynchronous: requests are accepted quickly, processed by workers, and every attempt is recorded in delivery logs. Idempotency and rate limiting protect both the platform and its users.

features.title: API-key authentication
features.description: Per-project API keys with rate limiting.

features.title: Idempotent sending
features.description: Idempotency so retried requests never send the same notification twice.

features.title: Templates & scheduling
features.description: Reusable message templates and scheduled delivery.

features.title: Delivery logs
features.description: Every delivery attempt recorded for debugging and auditing.

features.title: Reusable media service
features.description: PostgreSQL metadata, object storage, asynchronous processing and lifecycle management.

architecture.description: FastAPI API on PostgreSQL with Redis and Celery workers for asynchronous message processing. API, PostgreSQL, Redis and Celery run as Docker Compose services.

challenges.solution: Combined idempotency keys, asynchronous workers and delivery logs, so retries are safe and every message's fate is visible.

projects.title: School Management System
projects.summary: Full-featured school management system: students, academics, attendance, grading, finance, reporting and administration — in PHP/CodeIgniter, with modernization to CodeIgniter 4.
projects.overview:
A large school management system built and maintained at Grandstande Software. It covers students, academics, attendance, grading, finance, reporting and administrative workflows for schools.

Alongside feature work, I optimized database queries, debugged production issues and contributed to modernizing the codebase from CodeIgniter 3 to CodeIgniter 4. The related EduVision AI work covered academic, finance, grading, attendance and reporting modules.

features.title: Students & academics
features.description: Student records, academic structure and grading.

features.title: Attendance
features.description: Attendance tracking with administrative workflows.

features.title: Finance & reporting
features.description: School finance and reports for administrators.

features.title: CodeIgniter 4 modernization
features.description: Contributed to moving the application from CodeIgniter 3 to CodeIgniter 4.

architecture.description: PHP CodeIgniter MVC application on MySQL, being modernized from CodeIgniter 3 to CodeIgniter 4.

challenges.problem: Performance and reliability of a large production system
challenges.solution: Optimized database queries and debugged production issues to improve reliability and performance.

projects.title: Tour Ticket Booking System
projects.summary: Booking system for tour tickets with customer, transaction and payment workflows, integrated with Chapa and Telebirr.
projects.overview:
A tour ticket booking system designed at Grandstande Software. Customers book tours and pay online; the system manages bookings, customers and transactions end to end.

Payments are processed online through Chapa and Telebirr.

features.title: Bookings
features.description: Tour ticket booking and customer management.

features.title: Transactions
features.description: Transaction records tied to each booking.

features.title: Online payments
features.description: Secure payment processing with Chapa and Telebirr.

architecture.description: Booking, customer, transaction and payment modules, with Chapa and Telebirr integrated as payment providers.

projects.title: Vehicle Booking Management System
projects.summary: Booking management for a large transportation business: vehicles, customers, suppliers, bookings and payments — including a login response made more than 17 seconds faster.
projects.overview:
A vehicle booking management system built at Colink Software for a large transportation business. It manages vehicles, customers, suppliers, bookings and payment workflows.

Beyond features, much of the work was production engineering: optimizing slow endpoints and database queries, and resolving issues involving payments, transactions, database concurrency and deadlocks.

features.title: Fleet & bookings
features.description: Vehicles, customers, suppliers and bookings in one system.

features.title: Payments
features.description: Payment workflows attached to bookings.

features.title: REST APIs
features.description: Authentication, validation and client-server communication over REST.

architecture.description: REST API backend with authentication, validation and payment workflows serving the booking clients.

challenges.problem: A login that took far too long
challenges.solution: Optimized the login endpoint and its database queries, cutting response time by more than 17 seconds.
Diagnosed and resolved production issues involving transactions, database concurrency and deadlocks.

projects.title: Vega Grading System
projects.summary: Multi-tenant school grading SaaS: each school gets an isolated PostgreSQL schema, with academic structure, audited marks and a weighted grading engine.
projects.overview:
A SaaS platform for schools to manage assessments and grades. Each school registers as a tenant with its own PostgreSQL schema.

Admins define the academic structure, teachers record marks, and a grading engine computes weighted results. Mark changes are audited, and a React UI serves teachers, homeroom teachers and administrators.

features.title: Schema-per-tenant isolation
features.description: django-tenants: each school is a PostgreSQL schema resolved from its domain.

features.title: Academic structure
features.description: Years, grades, sections and subjects per school.

features.title: Weighted grading engine
features.description: Component score = raw mark ÷ maximum × weight; course totals out of 100.

features.title: Audited marks
features.description: Every mark change is recorded.

features.title: Role-based UI
features.description: Teacher, homeroom-teacher and admin experiences in React.

architecture.description: Django + DRF with django-tenants (public schema for tenants and domains, one schema per school), JWT auth scoped to the tenant, React + Vite frontend, Docker Compose.

challenges.solution: Audited endpoints and token paths for tenant leakage and scoped authentication to the current schema.

projects.title: Vega — Professional Portfolio Platform
projects.summary: This site. A portfolio SaaS where each user maintains one structured professional profile — with skills backed by evidence — that powers their public portfolio.
projects.overview:
Vega started as my personal portfolio and is becoming a platform that helps Ethiopians build a credible professional identity. Every user maintains one master profile — experience, education, projects, skills, certificates, languages — and outputs such as the portfolio site are generated from it.

Skills are evidence-based: each skill links to the projects and roles that prove it.

features.title: One profile, many outputs
features.description: Structured profile data feeds the public portfolio at /u/<username>.

features.title: Evidence-based skills
features.description: Each skill shows the projects, roles and certificates that use it.

features.title: Owner-isolated multi-tenancy
features.description: Every row belongs to a user; the owner API returns 404 for anyone else's data.

features.title: JWT auth with rotation
features.description: Email login, refresh-token rotation and blacklisting, throttled auth endpoints.

architecture.description: Django + DRF with a public read-only API (/api/u/<username>/) and an authenticated owner API (/api/me/). React + Vite + Tailwind frontend. Docker Compose.

challenges.problem: Turning a single-user site into multi-tenant SaaS
challenges.solution: Added an owner to every model, made uniqueness per owner and split the API into public and owner surfaces, with isolation tests.
